title: Replicated campsisnca table JSON Schema

selected_statistics.description: NCA metrics statistics to keep (e.g. mean, etc) when summary statistics are computed on replicated output.

summary_stat_display.description: Display format for replicate statistics. E.g. '{median} ({p5}–{p95})' or ['{median}', '{p5}', '{p95}']. See documentation on campsisnca repository.

summary_stat_signif_digits.description: Number of significant digits to display for replicate statistics.

strata.description: Named strata filters used to subset the dataset. See nca_strata definition.

title.description: Title to use for the replicated NCA table (optional).

subtitle.description: Subtitle to use for the replicated NCA table (optional).

tab_options.description: (Gt)-table options that will be passed to gt when the table is rendered.

nca_strata.description: Named strata filters used to subset the dataset (e.g., ARM, SCENARIO). Each property name represents a column and its value the level to select.
